tasks.label: lunokOS: emulator
tasks.detail: Builds and runs the binary with stdin attached to the terminal. pio -t upload is not used: PlatformIO pipes stdio, so the prompt never shows and the keyboard does not reach the program. The board is required: the emulator is the model it is told to be, hardware included (docs/85).

tasks.label: lunokOS: seed emulator disk
tasks.detail: Copies the assembled disk (build/disk: data/ plus apps/) into emulator/littlefs. Only for a run of a private disk (--flash emulator/littlefs): with no --flash the emulator reads build/disk itself.

tasks.label: lunokOS: check versions
tasks.detail: Law 10 over what a push would carry (origin/main..HEAD): every commit raises kernel::kVersion, the `version` of the manifest of every app it touches and the `version` of the library.json of every library it touches; and apps/about/res/libs.txt, which is generated from those numbers, says the same. It is what the CI runs (docs/80).
tasks.command: python3 tools/check_version.py origin/main HEAD && python3 tools/gen_about.py --check
